notes.title: The first game update
notes.notes:
Hi guys,
the very first update is finally live! It's first of the upcoming few (since I'm finally able to work full-time with I, Zombie). 

[b]What has changed?[/b] In general - game was ported from XNA to Unity3D. 

[b]What it means?[/b] From now on it'll be easier for me to work with next updates - which means there'll be more of them. Also, few bugs were fixed.

[b]Which ones?[/b] Pathfinding is a lot better, XNA-specific problems also shouldn't occur anymore, graphics was slightly improved and the game balance was changed (just a little bit).

[b]What next?[/b] In few upcoming weeks there's gonna be some updates containing among others:
- mouse support,
- additional levels with [b]new graphics theme[/b],
- and finally, later on (Q1 of 2016) - [b]level editor[/b]!

Also - sincere apologies for making you wait such a long time. I promise, I'll do better! ;)

Have fun!

[b]Also! If any issue with update occurs try uninstalling the game and re-downloading it again. The game structure has changed and Steam sometimes has problems with checking differences. Sorry for inconvienience![/b]
